summary: The MaintActivityCodes system facilitates the management and maintenance of activity codes within the HSPnet framework. It provides functionalities for adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating activity codes. It utilizes a user interface with panels and controls for displaying error and warning messages, and dropdowns for filtering activity codes by agency, department, and program.
purpose: To manage and maintain activity codes, allowing users to perform operations such as add, edit, deactivate, and reactivate codes within a structured UI.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the activity code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: A short form of the activity code's name.

fields.name: Inactive
fields.description: Indicates whether the activity code is inactive.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Represents the current user's session including their access rights.

workflows.name: Activity Code Maintenance
steps: User uses dropdowns to filter activity codes by agency, department, and program.
User can add a new activity code using the add button.
User can edit an existing activity code by selecting it and using the edit option.
User can deactivate an activity code using the deactivate control.
User can reactivate an inactive activity code using the reactivate control.
Changes are reflected on the UI grid, which updates after each operation.

business_rules: Activity codes must have a unique name within a program.
Changes to activity codes should only be allowed if the user has appropriate permissions.
The activity code cannot be added if the program or department dropdowns are empty.
conditions: Screen is editable if the user's agency matches the selected agency and the user has appropriate administrative rights.
system_behavior: Displays appropriate error and warning messages based on operations.
Refreshes data display upon changes to selection criteria or after CRUD operations.
dependencies: Dropdown controls are dependent on data sources from agencies, departments, and programs.
exceptions: No data found message displayed if no records match the current selection criteria.
